purpose: verify PTG profile claims vs corpus result

claims: In all 548 FR2 .ptg files the header satisfies count == columns*rows, stride == cell, columns == ceil(width/cell) and rows == ceil(height/cell), with zero violations.
The 17 .ptg files whose last header word is 0xDDDDDDDD all have sizes exactly equal to 1120 + 1104 times their tile count.

In those 17 files the first two float words of each 16-byte pointer record equal the fraction of the tile that lies inside the image at that tile's row-major position, which is also what identifies the 10 half-height tiles of posnscrn.ptg.
The pointer values in those records are not offsets into the file because they exceed the file size.
No palette was located in these files, and palette location, pointer meaning and descriptor constants are recorded as unresolved rather than decoded.
The tiles of these 17 files are stored in a permuted order that is not row-major.
The colors of the PTG images have been decoded.
All 48 tests pass and pyright reports zero errors on the new files.
